oh man, what was i getting into....................

There i had my account, i drew out all the money from my broker, i just didnt trust anything at this point.

I opened up a demo account, ibfx was the broker with the biggest flashing ads. lol......you know you just have to.

Now i had no clue, so i had to learn how to place orders and close them, that took me a number of goes. To be really honest i didnt have a clue what i was doing.

And read the market, all i could see were candle things going up or down.

i searched for forex and one well known forum come up, there i started to look for a way ahead. many indicators and theories were tried.

I ended up like this, hmmmm.......i guess many others go through this too.

Then i found this guy that talked about naked charts and used pinbars and outside bars. Finally i could see something in the charts. coupled with this support and resistance idea, it looked pretty good. Thats where my demo account started to become a serious tool. I discovered about trends and how to add on pullbacks.

After some toying around with my demo account, i looked around for more information on how to handle an account. There was a lot of information on trading plans and risk, this is where i dug quite deep

This interested me more than profit.

First i thought in order to grow it i must first protect it. So the plan, after much jigging around was formed.

It allowed me to close out losing positions early and let good trades run.

I still use this plan today Although my entries and exit style has changed everything else is the same.

I set out from this point to manage my trades on a fresh demo account and if i could i remain profitable, even slightly in 6 months time i would go live. Well i blew a couple up, we all do, eh.

The main point was to grow the demo account, but keep the risk exposure to a minimum. So little growth was still growth.

My risk per trade was set to 2% per trade and for me to have no more than 2 trades open, unless 1 was locked in profit. then another position could be opened.

Now bear in mind, there was no race and i didnt have a ego as big as my demo account. It proves nothing, its arrogant and i have no time for it. So cross me with it at your risk.

Running a demo account, risking to large % or having 40% ish in a minus on your floating profit or loss. Yes there is captain ego over on another forum behaving just like this in order to stroke his ego.

IT HAS NO PLACE.............................IT HAS NO PLACE, i had to say it twice, because your ego in this industry will get you smashed.

letting positions run against you, not sticking to your plan and screwing with your risk, maybe great when your playing the game of DEMO. But in a LIVE account it will end up with you puking in the toilet. MARGIN CALL!

The habits your form now are the ones you carry with you, they are like baggage that are very hard to shift.

You can spend years ignoring the truth, and wonder why 8 years down the line you cant make this work. You know the honest answer, its because while you were dicking around, the only person you cheated was yourself.

I was using confluence of pinbars and outside bars at trendlines and stacking orders on pullbacks. support and resistance played a key part too, but failed and i couldnt understand one thing.

If i had a previous high and price was slightly falling short on the next visit, then dropping hard, why was this. It left a unsolved puzzle in my mind.

My demo account after 6 months was nicely in the green, i felt ready to take the next step and go live. I loaded a small amount and proceeded to work as i had done previously. Following my plan and keeping my risk low, this made logical sense to me.

It was backed up by going on FF and watching people throw money away by having no clue and going at it hap hazzard. There i met a crazy northern guy, he was mocking the "know all, know nothing " bunch. It seemed to make sense what he was showing. I do hunt information out when i feel its going to be good, so i found his thread.

It was Redsword, i must have read through his thread twice over the next few days, i felt i had found the missing part of the puzzle.

posts.text:
Just another stage in the journey.......................

After a number of chats with Red, some things began to click. When i looked at the charts i focused and tried to look for poles, looking at the base of the pole where the source is. Then i could see a return to the base of the pole (the source).

I could see this supply and demand on the chart. But i couldnt really trade it. I just didnt see why some zones held and others not.

Now i had been looking at charts for a few years by this point and i trained my eye to pick up the areas of interest first and work from there. The more you do something,your brain becomes accustomed to recognizing to filtering out what it doesn't need, or it feels it doesn't.

Your mind is a sorting machine, you want to retain good information and disregard misinformation, this will take time.

How much time will depend on you, usually the time it takes to rewire your brain occurs as you experience positive and negative effects. But it depends on how you address them.

Accept that you will always have losing trades, it is how many you have and what risk exposure your account has in the market.

That is something i have always thought that needs to take first place. So my account has always had a number of small loses and a number of bigger wins. My account could go a few days with not much positive activity and then a nice trade would come off and blow away the small loss.

You will find that your account growth will always move in surges and lulls. But when you look at it over time it is constantly building. Do not be disheartened at this. And also do not alter from your trading plan in order to get quick fix trades.

After sometime with Red i was using a combination of the old s/r, trendlines and pa. And looking at poles, up to supply or down to demand. My focus was on a return to the source or base of pole. At times this worked well, as we now know it is only part of the story.

From the moment you start trading you begin to find out the type of person you are and where your weaknesses cause you problems. This is vital that you embrace this as you develop.

I can not scalp to save my life, i spent 6 months full time where i had daily swings going and scalped during the day also. My scalping side was really break even. Where my swings were just as the have been for a long time profitable.

Does this mean i cant trade?

NO, of course not, it just means i am more suited or wired for longer tf.

So, if i had learnt and stayed a scalper i would have probably given up by now.

The question that can decide your fate is "What type of trader are you?"

There are a thousand ways to skin this cat, what is your way?

Trading is about self discovery, you learn heaps about the type of person you are and this spills out into other areas of your life. Trading or any other activity in your life is a working part, If it runs badly, it effects other parts.

Think of it like a car, all parts must work in order to have a whole working vehicle. Something important packs up and nothing else can be utilized.

It is a known fact that the average working class person spends more time planning their next holiday than they do planning their financial future.

There is a difference between "The Have and the Have nots". Its all in the mindset,you keep thinking and doing things like a poor person and thats all you will ever be. Or you can think like a rich person does and you can start to do as they do.

Give 5k to a average working class person and they think "what can i spend it on"

Give 5k to a rich person and they will think "What can i invest it on"

This was the biggest hurdle for me, watching my account grow from 3 to 4 to 5 figures and more, it gets harder to keep your hands off it and let it grow. I had a figure in mind where i wanted to get to, which i reevaluated every year. Why?, its what rich people do, they monitor everything.

Where have i come from?

Where am i now?

Where am i going to?

You see when you make it past demo, it opens up another set of issues LIVE account trading and the games it plays on our mind. But once we are successfully building our account, after sometime things can start getting serious.

What goals are you working towards?

are they material or financial, Family or relationship based. Moving home or moving country. How will this money impact your life? How will it change and shape your future.?

All these things need planning.

What are you going to do about tax and paying what is due?

Will you start a ltd company or a trust?, with these surplus funds will you venture into property or start some kind of business? How will you keep the tax you are liable to pay to a minimum?

How will you protect what you have?

Spread the money between different brokers, spread money in different bank accounts.

If you have made excessive amounts and you have broker accounts, property, precious metals,art, businesses.

How much of a percentage will you keep as liquid cash? and will the % value need to change from time to time.

Will your success change the social circles you move in? Will people change their view of you? be it positive or negative, it will happen.

Will you tell everyone openly about your spoils and worth? or keep it quiet and just keep yourself to yourself?

When you have money and it shows, the % of people trying to extract that money from you will grow, as they use legal or illegal methods to acquire it from you. Be assured, they will.

How does this money effect your partner and your children? What happens when you die?

Best make sure these things are in place ahead of time, you will now when they are needed.

I asked myself these questions years ago, they made logical sense at the time. I have be implementing and reviewing ever since.

Do i know where i am going next? Sure i do

Am i prepared for it? Absolutely

I'm pretty new here but I think this is my favourite thread so far!

What stands out to me is that your style seems incredibly similar to mine which is always encouraging. It's easy to see what other people are doing and allow it to sway your thinking so whilst all of my success comes on higher timeframes and picking the coast to coast moves like you've described here, I see some of these charts people post where they seem to have taken every swing to the pip on a 5min chart or whatever it might be and it can make you feel very inferior!

Knowing yourself is such a key thing and I've learnt that for me, if I try to scalp/day trade I end up messing about with the order too much, I do far better taking trades on the hourly and above and then just leaving them and treating it as mechanically as possible. The other key is I use tight stops and try to enter as close to the zones as possible so if it does break the zone I'm trading from I'm out straight away. It means plenty of losses, (around 30-40% of my trades are losses) but my winning trades are always far bigger than the losses.

I would sum up my approach as purely statistical. I don't worry about whether any individual trade is a winner or a loser, the only thing I care about is whether I feel the trade I've entered has given me a statstical edge. The key factor for myself in the journey to becoming consistently profitable was getting to grips with the mental approach, not the technical approach (although that's of course hugely important as well). Learning to let my trades run to their targets was the key and the only way I could do that was to detatch myself from the individual trade results and look at the bigger picture, again that's pretty much what you've explained earlier on.

Anyway sorry to bombard your thread with this essay! I was just really chuffed to see your trading and your mindset was so similar in style to mine, very encouraging!

Story of a mis-spent youth

23.00hrs on 19th November an alarm triggered on my mobile phone "Aud/Jpy Daily supply" After some analysis and a nice little engulf, i waited for a retrace for my entry.

Yawnnnnnn, off to bed i went. All set and done!

Nice to see this morning, price had moved away and fallen over night. Not bad, with a 3 or 4 pip drawdown, not quite IF style, but the right route for me.

Now i do not move my stop down, i let it run to TP, price can return to fill more orders and if your stop is now at breakeven then it's good bye!

Quite a bit of chop around this afternoon with News and such like but after seeing sneeky little engulfs lower, then finding supply above only to drop and make new lows.

I have looked at charts and thought i have no clue where this is going. Now, we all use patterns and thanks to the guys here they do look symmetrical and pretty. Sometimes it is hard to see were supply or demand is in the middle of a chop, but they are there.

IF wrote this somewhere........The patterns may not all be the same, but they all have the same rhyme

Ahhhhh, the mis spent youth bit...........

As i approached our property, i could see that the last leg down on Aud/Jpy was on the way to hitting my Take profit. Casually walking inside, Jared (my Son) and Two of his friends were in our Kitchen, i held up my iphone to show them the current trade and explained that it was just about to hit the red line, which is my TP line. One of the Lad's piped up "Is that real, How much is that then" i replied with "does it matter?"

Now these lads, kind of know what i do.

"It is 100 pip travel" i said

"How much, i say, how much you made?"

"If it was £10 per pip"

This is like the point where i can hear the clockwork sound of a teenager's brain!

"That like......... a Grand....innit! (You cant buy this it is priceless)

"Well it could of been 2 pence per pip. But you are not to know that, are you? I explained"

After a long pause " 2 quid" he screeched!. He burst out laughing. But, only him, Jared knows otherwise.

I looked him in the eye and said "the amount is irrelevant, it is the process what is important!" When you have the process down to a "T", then it can be any amount.

To watch the interest drain from anyones face, is something i am sure we all have had to to endure at some point or other.

I was in the mood by that point to start my 30 min discussion, That is what Jared calls it! Anytime i want to make a point of something.

I took great delight, in explaining that, there is nothing like instant gratiication, so if it was a grand.....anything was possible and quick. But we know, our whole culture is filled with people thinking they can have it yesterday!

Society has been conditioned to accept that instant gratification is what we seek and every minute of every day must be exciting and different!

If a challenge or a project requires effort and will not bear fruit for sometime in the future, it is disregarded as a norm.

My wife, would rather try all 500 diets there has ever been and apply them a different way

Vs

Eat less and run round the block once a day.

Guess what, one doesnt work, the other one does! But whatever it is......................EFFORT is required

So, just grind away at the process of trading and it will become second nature, quite boring, but it will work.

NERVES, i can only say that it comes from the nagging doubt in your mind that you cant do it. It is a self doubt.

I use to take Jared over the court at our sport centre and he used to put up 500 made shots, off the dribble, catch and free throws in between. His own rule was, if he looked down while doing a complex dribble before his shot he knocked out 5 push up as soon as the ball left his hands. And was ready to shoot again the moment i rebounded.

He was punishing himself, for looking down on complex moves, always pushing! It was painful to watch at first, but he made the adjustments and the drills become easier.

Take a free throw, it is the same shot everytime. You just need perfect form. If you repeat, repeat and repeat until you are sick of it, concentrate on the detail. Your body remembers every little motion in the move!

Its called muscle memory, this produces unconscious competence. These two phases are in every aspect of learning.....................Trading is no different.!

A NEW YEAR MESSAGE FOR ALL.

This is the year YOU take control!

Is it the start of a New Year and a NEW you or will it be like all the other years full of empty promises.

You can not even blame others, because you made those promises to yourself. I bet they were the wishy washy kind, with no plan or goals. Just a “ I wish this year could be better” and by the end of January 2013 it was a distant memory.

Now I guess that you being here on this forum you have at least taken some action! But is it enough?

It starts and ends with this word CONTROL

You are either in control or you are controlled, that’s the brutal truth.

Every situation you have experienced and will experience in life is the outcome of someone being in control.

Be it, your Boss, Spouse, Family member, Friend, Bank manager, Creditor, Broker, Traffic Warden, Government official.

You see the truth of the matter is, if you do not plan or you stick your head in the sand regard to anything you need to address, someone else WILL take control of the situation! Eg: Your Boss controls you because you have placed yourself before him to serve under the contract you have signed. You are under his/her safety umbrella. They pay you, give you holiday entitlement, pay into a pension, a safe place to work

You have GIVEN them control over that aspect of your life.

Be it positive or negative.

The more you turn your back and let someone else deal with it, the less control you will feel in your life.

Successful people are aware of this life rule and set out to rid or minimize these controlling factors.

They understand that some forms of control can not be totally unchained, but managed into a happy medium. Other forms of control they rid themselves from. Think back to many different situations this past year, were you in control or just controlled and helpless to stop it?

Did the situation work out in your favour or the other party?

I will tell you, many a journey starts with the wanting of being successful…….mine did!

The more controlling influences there are in your life, the heavier the chains will be that keep you down. Until you can break those chains one at a time, success will be out of reach. For as you break each chain, you will feel lighter and lifted, a most empowering experience. The dreams you once had can start to be realised.

What will this year hold for you?

Will you be at 31st Dec 2014, with a heavy heart?

You may already be on the way or realising your dreams now, if so, why are you still reading this?

The truth has a habit of hitting a raw nerve, we can put a front on “yeah I am OK”

But deep down we know its not true, like a pain in the side that wont go away.

You know life doesn’t have to be this way, you can almost taste the good that is awaiting you…….its that close.

Whatever you want in life you need to fight for it, but not all fight is physical, some is mental. It is not about how many hours you work or how many trades you do in 24hrs.

It is work SMART, not HARD!

So if you make any kind of loose promise tonight, you may want to think who is waiting on the other side of 1st January 2014 to control your life. FROM tomorrow build it into your plan, what do you need to change in order for you to control more aspects of your life.

CONTROL OR BE CONTROLLED CONTROL OR BE CONTROLLED CONTROL OR BE CONTROLLED CONTROL OR BE CONTROLLED CONTROL OR BE CONTROLLED

Whats it gonna be?

There is no nastiness involved in taking control, but someone has to do it.

Who’s life is it anyway?

See you on the other side.

Your Friend Warren

Hi TLN, sorry for my late reply.

Thank you for your question and feel quite free (as anybody else too) to discuss my reply if you wish. I am not a Master and you even don't see anything similar to a Silver color around my nick

, just to say that whatever I'll mention is a lesson to myself too.

(Well, I guess it always is for a Master too....)

So, to the charts.

I must admit that I had to look a bit at the recent candles of Gbp/Aud to may find the right point in the chart.

It was kind to mention the TF, but I think it would help any reader (of your future Journal too) if you could upload your charts including the "frame", so to may see the Price level, TF and more coordinates to find it later on your own platform (as there are several difference from broker to broker too).

I had a look at your analysis and I must say that, considering my risk acceptance level, I would have probably taken that trade, even if you will read on the H4 Chart that something was not 100% clear to give Green Light to Go. ALWAYS keep in mind where you are in the HTF. We often tend to concentrate on the LTF, and lose the way inside the Labyrinth.

S/R Flip is not mandatory to me. It adds value. Confluence is a great thing.

What I think is important is the EG of a previous Support or Resistance. Somebody said in a video " I know you may be shocked from what I say, but we are more S/R Traders than Supply/Demand Traders "!

Now, what is a Resistance, what a Support? In my way to see at price they are nothing else than a FTR, than a FL. A single wick can be a Support or Resistance, not necessarily reacting at a previous one, creating a Flip zone. They are somehow Single Decision Points too. Mandatory is to see IF Price decides to respect or not to respect one of them.

All the rest, in between....is a PAZ, due to be passed through as soon as the door is open, like wind in a room.

Your Trade would have been a positive one.

My advices are:

1) We need to avoid the "middle of nowhere" and find the Patience to wait for Key Levels. Sooner or later Price gets there. No alternative. THERE we have to look for the most possible Massive R/R.

2) read and re read the Stars of these pages (I still do it often and appreciate it every time more). Same with the Videos.

What we need to do is repeat and repeat. It is just like going somewhere you had never been before.

The first time you are quite happy if you get there at all, the second you already recognize something... If you do the same way over and over again, you start to see details that you could never imagine before. We all know this story. I think no difference in Price reading.

BUT - also on the street you will always see People walking with no idea of where they are or what are doing, and People walking with a more clear step and a special light in the eyes.

I think same is here too

Here my charts of your Trade. Let's share ideas and get there step by step. ( there is more than enough to gain, even for those who remain in the backstage

posts.text:
Hi People! A bit a long post, but I wanted to make myself a present today, so I just wrote it. Hope nobody minds about that.

Today I am happy: Not only because it’s Friday, but also because it is a nice day in my “Trading Journey”.

For sure for many of you, more experienced Traders, that’s nothing special at all, I can well understand it. But for me it is a probably very important Milestone I was looking for.

No, I am not starting Trading Full Time – unfortunately still Light Years far away from that. Just something “small”, but made me happy and I worked for this.

I would like therefore to Thank ALL the great People here, sharing concepts of Price Reading I never saw before, which for sure helped me to do what I did.

I found here lots of Knowledge and also very Nice People too, who today are my Friends and I hope will be for a long Time.

I would also like to share my experience with you “People like me”, still at the beginning of the Way, with the hope to may give you a bit of motivation to continue to get up again.

Some will probably think I am doing it for the usual “Need” of some of us to show “how good I am”. Well, you surely have the right to think what you wish, but No, that’s not my reason. Really no need anymore for that.

If there’s even only one Trader out there, thinking in this moment to “ not be good enough” or “ should quit and forget it”, well my hope is to may give a message to that Trader: you are wrong. You probably still just need some time and Study to find your way. And with Peace in Mind, you MUST get up again.

I like Rocky’s sentence: “It ain't about how hard you hit. It's about how hard you can get it and keep moving forward. How much you can take and keep moving forward. That's how winning is done”

It’s a long way, today I understand it to be tiled with lots of Patience, Waiting, Compromises to be accepted (which belong to Patience perhaps and are not at all something bad. Instead I discovered “compromises” in Trading to be a Virtue of your own “Psychological Balance”, a way of communication with the Market and your Trading Style), Discipline. A way of a kind of Meditation may be?

Not a “WOW, I AM THE BEST, I’LL HAVE MY OWN HELICOPTER IN A COUPLE OF MONTHS YEAH YEAH…” …not at all….

In my opinion, the way is something very Silent, is your own “Balance”. To find that “Comfortable Area” for you, probably the famous “Zone”?

I think it may be a wide Zone, of your Psychology, showing yourself – and just yourself-who you are. And leading you to take your best possible Trading Decisions.

To find the Lot size you feel nice with, to be able to recognize and wait for the setups you like most and don’t get too much involved in all small details, which may be the “Zone” for someone else, but not necessarily for you too.

Ok, to the story:

My Vision (like most of us) is to one day Trading for Living, but I know (like most of us) that to achieve that you need a certain starting capital, allowing you to Trade “comfortably” with a Lot size that can, at the end of the month, ensure you and your Family a decent Life.

I don’t have that amount, so I was hoping to may find a professional trader (or a trusted Fund

) who could trade and grow for me a small account of money, so that I could

learn from his trades and at the same time gain some money during I am at work. Paying of course the due fee, it’s a business, nothing bad with that.

But it really seems not so easy to find somebody ready to do that, showing you to be really profitable and having neither something to hide, nor the fair to fail in front of others. Anyway I have a project in my mind, and I think I’ll do it when I’ll be able to.

The Simple Story is that at the beginning of August I funded a real account, because I thought I found someone, and agreed what was to agree.

Nothing very impressive, therefore I don’t really think to have the need to hide anything and can use the real numbers to explain. It was 2000 Euro, that changed into a USD account became (deducted the costs) 2.071 USD. For me enough money, for many surely one day Trading or even less.

I will neither say who this trader is, nor I would ever allow myself to say either he is a good trader or not. I am not here to judge.

What I can only say is that after about 40 / 50 trades I was down more than I expected.

It was not what I was expecting from a trader I was thinking profitable.

Of course, a losing raw may surely happen, but in my case I had really too many loser and too less winners. Very different than the posts I saw somewhere.

The balance was going down day after day for about one month. So I decided (fully in Peace with him) to quit his service and to try take myself the boat under control.

I did it. I recovered the loss.

He was trading 0.2 mini lots, I decided instead to trade 0.1 and I could recover anyway all in a not too long time, even a bit more than my starting capital on the balance.

THEN, ONE DAY, THE TRAGEDY: I installed the MT4 of my broker on my pc at work.

As you surely all know, when you open the first time a Trade on your brand new MT4, the standard Lot Size shown is 1.0 lots….and you have to adjust it the first time, after that it remains in the memory of the MT4.

On my phone and on my pc at home I was used (during the recovery time) to trade 0.1 and didn’t even look anymore at the settings….just buy or sell. So I took a long from my pc at work….with 1 Full Lot!!!

Price went like a STONE against me in a second… someone said “ and then Murphy’s Law got enforced “. Nothing more True than that!

Panic. 200, 300, 400 lost…probably some news I didn’t check before…

I didn’t set a fixed SL (as I actually admit I still don’t do with my 0.1 mini lot even if all “schools” say you have to set it even before entering the trade) but in that case I lost my control…

I was HOPING price to get back to my entry or near… (and someone else said “ when in your Trading there’s any kind of HOPE than something is wrong with your Trading”)

I was just not ready yet to change my Way.

I started to think “ what the F..ck I did to my Family…2K are for us much money…all my hopes…and I am going to give them to some other Trader today… for what??? “

You probably know what you can be able to think in those situations. You start to think: Ok, at this point All or Nothing… Back to the Entry or Margin Call… Like a Kamikaze…

…Probably at this point I did something which changed my Trading Way for ever: - with a loss of 1.330 Usd….I closed the Trade…

I was DESTROYED inside…. I had now 818 Usd on the account and a Soul in Pieces inside…

But I didn’t accept anymore the Kamikaze way… took my destiny in MY hands, not in the Market ones…

I went in Zen Meditation

for a short time and decided to start from there again….but

with a clear mind. No revenge at all. Just Trading.

Today I achieved it. I got back to my starting balance, and stopped trading today for this reason. Just to sit a moment and look around. That’s the reason of my post. In exactly two months since my loss, I achieved it.

I learned really very much from that Loss. One of my now surely best Friends told me: “ you must learn to Gift the Market for a Lesson”. Today I know he was right.

I am glad now of that mistake AND of my Decision Point to Close that loser…

I have started to be patient, calm, to do it just step by step, to accept that even with 1 pip a day I could have brought me there. No Stress. No Rush. A kind of “quiet and serene positive humility “.

To understand that it’s not about posting charts, but about making money.

I got my “Mantra”….don’t be greedy…keep your mind free and cool…there’s no reason to let a winner get into a loser… (I actually had also several trades with really 1 or 2 pips...)

Time, Patience, Discipline and …very important for me… comfortable Lot Size (because I had some DD and do not shame at all. I know I will learn to reduce them, but I was ready to close again in loss if the DD was getting over the “logical possible level”.

After a certain time I started thinking: am I may be just “ Lucky”??? Well, may be. I still don’t know it and have no need to find it out. Or I perhaps just searched for the “simple” way.

Whenever wrote: Hi People! A bit a long post, but I wanted to make myself a present today, so I just wrote it. Hope nobody minds about that.

Today I am happy: Not only because it’s Friday, but also because it is a nice day in my “Trading Journey”.

For sure for many of you, more experienced Traders, that’s nothing special at all, I can well understand it. But for me it is a probably very important Milestone I was looking for.

No, I am not starting Trading Full Time – unfortunately still Light Years far away from that.

Just something “small”, but made me happy and I worked for this.

I would like therefore to Thank ALL the great People here, sharing concepts of Price Reading I never saw before, which for sure helped me to do what I did.

I found here lots of Knowledge and also very Nice People too, who today are my Friends and I hope will be for a long Time.

I would also like to share my experience with you “People like me”, still at the beginning of the Way, with the hope to may give you a bit of motivation to continue to get up again.

Some will probably think I am doing it for the usual “Need” of some of us to show “how good I am”. Well, you surely have the right to think what you wish, but No, that’s not my reason. Really no need anymore for that.

If there’s even only one Trader out there, thinking in this moment to “ not be good enough” or “ should quit and forget it”, well my hope is to may give a message to that Trader: you are wrong. You probably still just need some time and Study to find your way. And with Peace in Mind, you MUST get up again.

I like Rocky’s sentence: “It ain't about how hard you hit. It's about how hard you can get it and keep moving forward. How much you can take and keep moving forward. That's how winning is done”

It’s a long way, today I understand it to be tiled with lots of Patience, Waiting, Compromises to be accepted (which belong to Patience perhaps and are not at all something bad. Instead I discovered “compromises” in Trading to be a Virtue of your own “Psychological Balance”, a way of communication with the Market and your Trading Style), Discipline. A way of a kind of Meditation may be?

Not a “WOW, I AM THE BEST, I’LL HAVE MY OWN HELICOPTER IN A COUPLE OF MONTHS YEAH YEAH…” …not at all….

In my opinion, the way is something very Silent, is your own “Balance”. To find that “Comfortable Area” for you, probably the famous “Zone”?

I think it may be a wide Zone, of your Psychology, showing yourself – and just yourself- who you are. And leading you to take your best possible Trading Decisions.

To find the Lot size you feel nice with, to be able to recognize and wait for the setups you like most and don’t get too much involved in all small details, which may be the “Zone” for someone else, but not necessarily for you too.

Ok, to the story:

My Vision (like most of us) is to one day Trading for Living, but I know (like most of us) that to achieve that you need a certain starting capital, allowing you to Trade “comfortably” with a Lot size that can, at the end of the month, ensure you and your Family a decent Life.

I don’t have that amount, so I was hoping to may find a professional trader (or a trusted Fund

) who could trade and grow for me a small account of money, so

that I could learn from his trades and at the same time gain some money during I am at work. Paying of course the due fee, it’s a business, nothing bad with that.

But it really seems not so easy to find somebody ready to do that, showing you to be really profitable and having neither something to hide, nor the fair to fail in front of others. Anyway I have a project in my mind, and I think I’ll do it when I’ll be able to.

The Simple Story is that at the beginning of August I funded a real account, because I thought I found someone, and agreed what was to agree.

Nothing very impressive, therefore I don’t really think to have the need to hide anything and can use the real numbers to explain. It was 2000 Euro, that changed into a USD account became (deducted the costs) 2.071 USD. For me enough money, for many surely one day Trading or even less.

I will neither say who this trader is, nor I would ever allow myself to say either he is a good trader or not. I am not here to judge.

What I can only say is that after about 40 / 50 trades I was down more than I expected. It was not what I was expecting from a trader I was thinking profitable.

Of course, a losing raw may surely happen, but in my case I had really too many loser and too less winners. Very different than the posts I saw somewhere.

The balance was going down day after day for about one month. So I decided (fully in Peace with him) to quit his service and to try take myself the boat under control.

I did it. I recovered the loss.

He was trading 0.2 mini lots, I decided instead to trade 0.1 and I could recover anyway all in a not too long time, even a bit more than my starting capital on the balance.

THEN, ONE DAY, THE TRAGEDY: I installed the MT4 of my broker on my pc at work.

As you surely all know, when you open the first time a Trade on your brand new MT4, the standard Lot Size shown is 1.0 lots….and you have to adjust it the first time, after that it remains in the memory of the MT4.

On my phone and on my pc at home I was used (during the recovery time) to trade 0.1 and didn’t even look anymore at the settings….just buy or sell. So I took a long from my pc at work….with 1 Full Lot!!!

Price went like a STONE against me in a second… someone said “ and then Murphy’s Law got enforced “. Nothing more True than that!

Panic. 200, 300, 400 lost…probably some news I didn’t check before…

I didn’t set a fixed SL (as I actually admit I still don’t do with my 0.1 mini lot even if all “schools” say you have to set it even before entering the trade) but in that case I lost my control… I was HOPING price to get back to my entry or near… (and someone else said “ when in your Trading there’s any kind of HOPE than something is wrong with your Trading”)

I was just not ready yet to change my Way.

I started to think “ what the F..ck I did to my Family…2K are for us much

money…all my hopes…and I am going to give them to some other Trader today… for what??? “

You probably know what you can be able to think in those situations. You start to think: Ok, at this point All or Nothing… Back to the Entry or Margin Call… Like a Kamikaze…

…Probably at this point I did something which changed my Trading Way for ever: - with a loss of 1.330 Usd….I closed the Trade…

I was DESTROYED inside…. I had now 818 Usd on the account and a Soul in Pieces inside…

But I didn’t accept anymore the Kamikaze way… took my destiny in MY hands, not in the Market ones…

I went in Zen Meditation

for a short time and decided to start from there

again….but with a clear mind. No revenge at all. Just Trading.

Today I achieved it. I got back to my starting balance, and stopped trading today for this reason. Just to sit a moment and look around. That’s the reason of my post. In exactly two months since my loss, I achieved it.

I learned really very much from that Loss. One of my now surely best Friends told me: “ you must learn to Gift the Market for a Lesson”. Today I know he was right. I am glad now of that mistake AND of my Decision Point to Close that loser… I have started to be patient, calm, to do it just step by step, to accept that even with 1 pip a day I could have brought me there. No Stress. No Rush. A kind of “quiet and serene positive humility “.

To understand that it’s not about posting charts, but about making money.

I got my “Mantra”….don’t be greedy…keep your mind free and cool…there’s no reason to let a winner get into a loser… (I actually had also several trades with really 1 or 2 pips...)

Time, Patience, Discipline and …very important for me… comfortable Lot Size (because I had some DD and do not shame at all. I know I will learn to reduce them, but I was ready to close again in loss if the DD was getting over the “logical possible level”.

After a certain time I started thinking: am I may be just “ Lucky”??? Well, may be. I still don’t know it and have no need to find it out. Or I perhaps just searched for the “simple” way.

Trying to filter out lots of for me not useful information and looking for my “easy trades” only. 98% of them are only on Eur/Usd. All with 0.1 mini lots.

Someone very near to me (my Wife

) told me:

I am now curious to see how you will Trade AFTER the recover, because you will have not that goal anymore in front of you.

Very Very good question.

I am curios too, but that told me that perhaps what I need to do now is to set a new Goal to achieve. I will do it.

Now is time to reinforce the Patience, the Knowledge that “ I am not that good”, that I cannot allow myself to fall into the Trap of thinking “I got it, I can do it”, but “Flying low” as we say in Italy. Step by Step. I know there is still much to learn and to learn to control in my Trading, but I think I know more or less after these two months, what I have to adjust. And I have perhaps now the right calm state of mind for doing it seriously.

That’s all Friends. I’ll enjoy this weekend and let’s see what the future brings.

One is with the whole history. The second is the analysis of my Trading since “ The Day After “ till today.

Ok, now I have to say it. It is also a little bit to tell myself: “Good Job Whenever! I think that if you don’t do anything crazy, you could be on the right track….”

Thank You All, first of All the Group of Great People starting this Forum and this Project.

Grazie

Well, the only opinion I had when I saw it was: " WOW! Great. Textbook Trade ".

I could have been missing that Trade because Price didn't achieve the above supply, but the QM would have tempted me very strongly too. So probably in M5 or M1 at the Swap Level I could have found some sign of drop, like a EG and retest or similars.

Then look again at what happened there, were the Compression decided to jump up instead of falling down... That is also a very important point. I will never forget Harry's explanation about that.

Normally at that DP Price should have had a strong rejection up. Instead a small EG of the last Demand tells us what's the possibility...(the blue circle) In fact Price goes up again to look for further Supply and then drop again.

Blue is a long FL, red is a short FL, green is a zone to look for a trade, usually a LTF set of orders (the green zone is personal thing of mines, i don't think anyone else uses a green zone). You can see the Blue FLs swap to a Red FL and vice versa, as the FLs are getting broken. Imagine an FL is an area where a transaction is made to hold price up and down. When all the orders in that FL are cleared, the FL gets broken, another transaction is created to hold price the other way. So the FLs swap as they get broken.

posts.author: chrisb
posts.text:
The last FL you posted is correct (I marked it the same yesterday). But you cannot expect that EACH FL will reverse/bounce price. They just don't work like that:) FLs are barriers. When such barrier is broken then price wants next barrier. Apart from that some of them are far more important than others.

If you want reaction on a FL, then some additional circumstances must happen (remember that we read the price at RTM, we are not "pattern traders" like in standard technical analysis!) so we must read price intention before think about trade. One of such circumstance was mentioned by moneydeep in one of answers that you get recently (FL must engulf something to the left). There are many more which you will spot in the future.

Anyway I'm strongly recommend you to take all moneydeep tips into account and continue your work with FLs. Mark as many you can and then investigate why some fail and why some bounce price. And please don't repeat my fault and when practicing with FLs: mark not only one FL per chart, but try to mark many FLs on the single "view".

posts.author: MarkG
posts.text:
fendt wrote: But how are you to know that was the trick played in the past while trading in real time?

To the best of my knowledge, you don't often know with any certainty which level the good trade will be at. You might place a PO at each of the two potential levels, safe in the knowledge that at least one of them has a good chance of being successful and paying for the loss on the other if it comes to that.

There should be clues on approach that give you more confidence that it will turn price, such as engulfs on a lower TF.

You can play it safer, giving a chance for both levels to bring profit by placing the SL beyond both levels for both trades. The R will be reduced for the lower level in this case.

I realise that you must be very confident in the zone and the fact that it will stop price at some point within for any of this to be useful...
